title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 18
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'pillar width' in board and pillar mining depends on
options: It is fixed for all the mines of that country
It depends only on the depth of the mine workings
It depends on the size of the ventilation fan of the mine
Depth, strength of coal, and roof conditions
questions.solution: Pillar width depends on depth, coal strength, and roof conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support installation' in a drift must be done
options: It is used to support the conveyor belts of the mine workings
It is done after the full excavation of the mine has been completed
As soon as possible after excavation, before the next round
It is done at the end of the shift of that particular mine working
questions.solution: As soon as possible after excavation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine water pumping record' must be maintained by
options: It is done by the manager of that mine only in the mine area
The person responsible for pumping operations
It is done by the surface watchman of that particular mine
It is done by no one on the surface of that particular mine
questions.solution: The person responsible for pumping operations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The main danger from electrical equipment in coal mines is
options: Ignition of methane or coal dust by sparks or heat
Electromagnetic interference with telephones
Excessive noise at the switchgear panels
It is the overheating of the transformer oil of that mine
questions.solution: Ignition of methane or coal dust by sparks or heat.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'extraction sequence' in depillaring determines
options: It is the colour of the coal that is produced by that particular mine

It is the depth of the coal seam that is being worked at that mine
questions.solution: Extraction sequence determines safe pillar removal order.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)

options: The horizontal angle between points

The tonnage of coal at one place

questions.solution: Determines difference in elevation between points.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'auxiliary fan' is used to
options: To cool the mine of that particular mining area
Supplement ventilation in specific areas
To replace the main fan of that particular mining
To heat the mine of that particular mining area
questions.solution: Auxiliary fans supplement ventilation in specific areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)

options: Only the officers of the mine are permitted to do that work here
Only the owner representatives are permitted to do that work here
Competent persons including safety officer and workers' representative
Only the electrician and the fitter are permitted to do that work here
questions.solution: Competent persons including safety officer and workers' representative.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)

It is the seating comfort of the persons who ride in that vehicle
It is the horn of the vehicle that is used in the mine workings

questions.solution: Load capacity and safety before carrying passengers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)

options: Angle measurement, distance measurement, and data recording

questions.solution: Angle measurement, distance measurement, and data recording.

6 months
